name: Albert Park Circuit
fact: A temporary circuit around a lake in a city park. Traditionally opens the season.

name: Shanghai International Circuit
fact: The layout traces the Chinese character 'shang', meaning 'above'. Turn 1 tightens for what feels like forever.

name: Suzuka International Racing Course
fact: The only figure-of-eight track on the calendar. Home of the fearsome 130R and the S Curves.

name: Bahrain International Circuit
fact: A night race in the desert. Abrasive tarmac and strong winds make tyre management crucial.

name: Jeddah Corniche Circuit
fact: The fastest street circuit in F1, with average speeds above 250 km/h between the walls.

name: Miami International Autodrome
fact: Built around the Hard Rock Stadium, with a fake marina and a tight chicane under an overpass.

name: Circuit Gilles Villeneuve
fact: The final chicane's 'Wall of Champions' has claimed Schumacher, Hill, Villeneuve and Vettel.

name: Circuit de Monaco
fact: The jewel of the calendar. Slowest, tightest, and qualifying position is almost everything.

name: Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya
fact: The classic testing venue. If a car is quick here, it tends to be quick everywhere.

name: Red Bull Ring
fact: Short, hilly and fast. Lap times barely over a minute make qualifying brutally close.

name: Silverstone Circuit
fact: Host of the very first world championship race in 1950. Maggotts–Becketts is a high-speed masterpiece.

name: Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps
fact: The longest track on the calendar, home of Eau Rouge–Raidillon and famously changeable weather.

name: Hungaroring
fact: Twisty and dusty — 'Monaco without the barriers'. Overtaking is famously difficult.

name: Circuit Zandvoort
fact: Old-school dunes circuit with steeply banked corners. 2026 is its final Grand Prix for now.

name: Autodromo Nazionale Monza
fact: The Temple of Speed. Lowest-downforce setups of the year and the tifosi flood the track afterwards.

name: Madring
fact: Brand-new for 2026 around the IFEMA exhibition centre, featuring the steeply banked 'La Monumental'.

name: Baku City Circuit
fact: A 2 km full-throttle blast along the seafront, plus a castle section barely wider than a car.

name: Marina Bay Street Circuit
fact: F1's original night race. Heat and humidity make it one of the most physical races of the year.

name: Circuit of the Americas
fact: The steep climb to Turn 1 is one of the most dramatic starts on the calendar.

name: Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez
fact: At 2,200 m altitude the thin air cuts downforce and cooling. The stadium section is electric.

name: Autódromo José Carlos Pace
fact: Anti-clockwise, bumpy and full of history. Has decided many championships.

name: Las Vegas Strip Circuit
fact: Racing down the Strip at night, with top speeds well above 340 km/h.

name: Lusail International Circuit
fact: A flowing MotoGP track of fast, sweeping corners under floodlights.

name: Yas Marina Circuit
fact: The twilight season finale. Hosted title deciders in 2010, 2014, 2016, 2021 and 2025.
